data.name: Concerted Effort
data.description: A sunrider can extend the bond she shares with her horse to other nearby mounted companions, forming them into a fighting force that seems to share a single mind. Allied mounts within %1 feet of the sunrider gain evasion as per the animal companion special ability.|SunriderConcertedEffortRange

raw_tokens.value: A sunrider can extend the bond she shares with her horse to other nearby mounted companions, forming them into a fighting force that seems to share a single mind. Allied mounts within %1 feet of the sunrider gain evasion as per the animal companion special ability.|SunriderConcertedEffortRange
Allied mounts gain a +%1-foot enhancement bonus to their speed.|SunriderConcertedEffortSpeed|PRECLASS:1,Druid=6
Allied mounts also gain devotion as per the animal companion special ability.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=8
Allied mounts gain multiattack as per the animal companion special ability.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=10
Allied mounts gain a +2 bonus on saving throws.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=12
Allied mounts gain improved evasion as per the animal companion special ability.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=16
Allied mounts gain a +2 dodge bonus to their Armor Class and a +2 bonus on attack rolls.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=18
Allied mounts gain DR 5/- and energy resistance 10 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic damage.|PRECLASS:1,Druid=20
These abilities function only while allied mounts are within range of the sunrider (her own mount always counts as an ally).
